headline: On November 9, 1989: East Germany opened checkpoints in the Berlin Wall
captionCards: Over 500 people had been killed trying to cross the Iron Curtain
It ended decades of division between East and West Germany
instagramCaption:
Berlin Wall opened on November 9, 1989.

East German citizens flooded through newly opened checkpoints into West Berlin.

The announcement came during a Politburo press conference, mistakenly stating travel restrictions were lifted immediately.

Hundreds had died trying to cross the border before this moment.

It marked the end of decades of division and symbolized the collapse of communist control in Eastern Europe.

What would you have done if you stood at that wall that night?
